payload.reason: The evidence provides specific comparisons of models with ReWE against LSTM and transformer baselines across different datasets, indicating the baselines used for comparison.

claims.text: The models with ReWE have outperformed the LSTM and transformer baselines consistently across the en-fr dataset.
In the cs-en dataset, the LSTM+ReWE achieved the best results compared to the corresponding baselines.
For the eu-en dataset, ReWE outperformed the baselines by a large margin, indicating the baseline models used.
The transformer performed below the LSTM on the eu-en dataset, suggesting it was one of the baselines compared.
